event_name: Date 27 October 2018 Time 16:30 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 24) and heard the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 failed to follow the Race Director's Instruction in Turn 8.
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1 i. of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video and telemetry evidence, heard from the driver of car 18 (Lance Stroll) and team representative. The driver did not keep wholly to the right of the fluorescent yellow kerb after he had passed completely behind the T8 apex kerb. The Stewards understood that the driver had lost control at the previous corner and that as the painted run off area was damp, the speed at which the driver was travelling would have made attempting to negotiate the yellow kerb unsafe in such conditions. Further, he ensured that he re-joined the track in a safe manner, aborted the lap immediately and pulled off the racing line.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 28 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Decision Car 18 Turn 8 Incident 2Nd
